text: Everything is an illusion in the mundane world. Only your conviction is real.
author: Shibumi
visual_brief: Technical engineering diagram of a heavy mechanical gyroscope spinning perfectly upright at its center point, defined by crisp concentric gimbal rings and fine rotational motion arrows. Faint, turbulent fluid-flow lines and chaotic vector arrows swirl through the surrounding dark field without perturbing the rigid alignment of the central rotor.
alt: White line drawing of a steady gyroscope spinning amid turbulent vectors.
